corroboration.note: An extra zero in the printed article prefix excludes this cell from automatic extraction; the row and independent current Fabory article agree.

Current Wuerth product sheet independently confirms shorter/longer metric combinations.

notes: The previous lists were curated subsets, not standard limits. Missing from these finite catalogues never establishes unavailability.
Length is under-head for ordinary screws and includes the head for countersunk screws.
A listed article is catalogue evidence only; no claim of current stock, popularity, material/strength, complete standard coverage or load suitability.
Diameter and head/drive geometry remain the explicit DIN/ISO dimensions in hardware-reference.json. Replacement ISO head geometry must not be substituted for DIN.
Every added length has a primary catalogue article and matching PDF length cell, or an explicitly named supplier product variant. Packed article codes and mismatching/ambiguous cells were excluded.
Nuts, washers, proprietary rivet nuts and T-slot families retain their source-specific dimensions and are all covered by the existing 19-family geometry audit.

The total-range PDF is historical commercial evidence, not a live stock feed. The reported common DIN 912 M6 x 60 is additionally checked against current independent suppliers. Long/specialist lengths are not described as common.

additionalCatalogues.kind: Original supplier product variant data in the public HTML, not filter cross-products.
